name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1493: The four surviving Routine-I reds were specs pinned to superseded truths, not bugs: v1475 answered Konyo by PLANNING the 8 ladder-only runewords in the Forge lane instead of parking them in a read-only strip, so v632 and v634 asserted a strip that is empty by design - they now read the _forgeIncludeLadder setting and drive it, instead of depending on a default that changed sides. v552 asserted one phrasing of the Chronicle meter caption that v1474 rewrote. And TV_SESSIONS isolated exactly one of eleven journal sites, so a harness that set it read the real journal while five unrouted sites could append to it.
